objective: Exercise the exact Coulomb tolerance candidate on the eight-step M4 slip ramp.

case.name: R10 M4 slip_target
case.supports: all translations fixed at x=0; master plane fixed

contact.formulation: fixed initial-search node-to-triangle, normal Lagrange multipliers, regularized tangential Coulomb return
contact.normal_multiplier_unit: N; the solver's field name 'pressure' is a nodal constraint multiplier, not Pa

classification_review.rule: For positive capacity use epsilon * max(mu*p, 1 N); exact zero capacity cannot carry tangential load in the direct return.

per_contact_per_iteration: active flag and gap in m
normal multiplier and mu*p capacity in N
relative tangential displacement and slip-reference in m
trial and returned tangential force in N
numeric Coulomb force band and geometric gap tolerance
per_accepted_step: full displacement vector and applied load vector
fixed DOF map and TET4 node/element arrays
all contact states, gaps, normal multipliers, tangential forces and references
free and global balance metrics, residuals, step time and RSS
capture.raw_archive: compressed NPZ plus JSONL files retained only in the local controlled run store; not included in the product commit

budget_basis: Previously measured 32.68 s and 487 MiB for stick; 343.10 s and 480 MiB for slip. 480 s and 768 MiB accommodate instrumented capture. Output budget allows all instrumented JSONL records and raw arrays.
termination: Stop at the first solver rejection, failed gate, process limit, timeout, or archive validation failure. Preserve partial outputs; do not retry under this scope or ledger.

comparisons.stick: Same loads and builder as archived instrumented stick on 57e04bf3.
comparisons.slip: Same loads and builder as the archived scaled slip. Product overflow guard and Coulomb tolerance differ.
